name: Iowa DIAL Asbestos Licenses and Permits

agency.name: Iowa Department of Inspections, Appeals, and Licensing

termsReviewNotes: The Data Hub page lists CC BY, but normalized publication still needs source-specific privacy review because asbestos records can include individuals as well as businesses.
updateFrequency: weekly according to the Iowa Data Hub catalog page reviewed on 2026-07-03
licenseTypesIncluded: Iowa asbestos licenses listed in the Iowa Data Hub catalog
Iowa asbestos contractor/supervisor license discipline where present in the licensed-professional dataset
knownExclusions: The cataloged license dataset includes individual asbestos professionals and is not limited to contractor businesses.
The related asbestos permits dataset is a separate Iowa Data Hub dataset and should be reviewed before contractor-permit normalization.
This source is limited to Iowa asbestos licensing and permitting; it is not a general contractor, electrical, plumbing, or mechanical source.
rateLimitNotes: No adapter is implemented. Prefer saved fixtures and Data Hub export metadata review before any opt-in network sync.
publicRecordsNotes: DIAL links public lists of current permitted contractors and current licensed professionals. Absence from one downloaded snapshot is not proof that an asbestos credential or permit does not exist elsewhere.
officialLookupReviewNotes: The official DIAL asbestos license page links current permitted-contractor and licensed-professional Iowa Data Hub datasets.
officialBulkDownloadNotes: Iowa Data Hub exposes catalog pages for current asbestos licenses and permits with weekly update metadata; adapter work must still review API/export shape and privacy handling.
researchNotes: This source is intentionally separate from construction contractor registration because DIAL asbestos licensing and permitting are administered as a distinct asbestos program.
maintainerNotes: Future adapter work should decide whether the normalized source is licenses, permits, or a paired source family before exposing records.

researchEvidence.note: Official DIAL asbestos license page reviewed; it states asbestos workers, contractors, and supervisors must obtain licenses and links current permitted-contractor and licensed-professional lists.
Iowa Data Hub catalog page reviewed; it describes Iowa Asbestos Licenses, weekly update cadence, and public license metadata.
Iowa Data Hub catalog page reviewed; it describes Iowa Asbestos Permits, weekly update cadence, and permit dataset metadata.

blocker.summary: The official Data Hub path appears exportable, but no adapter-reviewed API/export shape, privacy filter, or fixture-backed parser has been implemented yet.
